pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with moderately sharp edge gradients on the neck and upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more rounded shapes on the lower flank and belly area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, light-colored interstitial pathways forming a interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly trilateral and quadrilateral, with relatively consistent pixel thickness across the mid-neck region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, upright mane with a low-amplitude, high-frequency silhouette along the upper neck and into the shoulder region.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark avian specimen perched on the posterior dorsal ridge area.
